title: Archive / Research Folios

subjects.identity: Four distinct upright translucent research folios made from clear glass and warm ivory acrylic, staggered in depth on a warm stone museum surface.

style: Quiet editorial museum display with fine abstract evaluation marks and restrained cobalt accents.
motion_intent: The frontmost folio slides toward the camera and rotates 12 degrees about its vertical axis, revealing the second folio; the other three remain fixed.
scene: Locked camera, warm ivory museum surface, soft directional daylight and physical shadows. Folios occupy center-right; left 35 percent remains quiet for editable HTML headline.
continuity: Keep exactly four folios and their etched abstract marks, material, dimensions and order consistent.
Only the front folio moves; it stays upright, does not bend, and never passes through another sheet.
Camera, museum surface, lighting and shadow direction stay fixed.
No readable words, numbers, logos, UI, page text or cuts in imagery.
